note: DEMO CONFIG (Phase 1) - NOT the real camera setup. One zone on the empty yellow armchair in data/demo/seat-event.mp4 (720x1280, shot vertically, camera pans). Used to prove a seat goes FREE -> BUSY from real detections. Use with: python run.py --camera data/demo/seat-event.mp4 --cameras data/cameras.seatevent.json

cameras.label: Demo clip - one seat event
cameras.notes: The zone is the intersection of the chair box across the whole clip, because the camera pans: chair boxes drift from x=111..672 at the start to x=73..491 at the end. The seat reads FREE while the chair is empty and BUSY as soon as the man's person box covers it - which happens slightly before he actually sits down, because the tracker only knows 'a person is in this rectangle', not what his legs are doing.
